headline: Every register, ledger and mark sheet, in one place.
intro: Attendance at the classroom door, fees at the counter, results at the end of term — recorded once and visible to everyone who needs them, from the principal's desk to a parent's phone.

line.fees: Fees at the counter, receipts in hand.
line.exams: Mark sheets ready by the end of term.
line.reach: From the principal's desk to a parent's phone.
